title: Decayed Frame Portal
description: An aged, ornate rectangular frame contains a surreal composition of nested, decaying rectangular frames arranged symmetrically against a marbled teal and purple background. The frames show heavy deterioration with peeling paint, cracks, and exposed material, creating a layered, receding tunnel effect.
prompt: A surreal painting featuring multiple nested rectangular frames in varying sizes arranged symmetrically within a larger ornate frame. The frames are heavily deteriorated with peeling paint, cracks and exposed texture, set against a marbled background of deep teal and purple with subtle white streaks. The overall effect creates a decaying portal-like tunnel, with visible physical wear and patina on all frame elements.
medium: painting on canvas with physical frame elements
